summary: 19 m kerb at a school junction with no-stopping signs and a house 12 m away.
reasons: Bus zone, 19 m at a junction

drivers.seclusion: Detached house 12 m away on the same side, more homes behind; school, church and a depot nearby.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb ends at a signalled junction with painted islands; no pull-off, and signs ban stopping.
drivers.traffic: Busy junction by a school; heavy at drop-off and pick-up.
drivers.convention: No Stopping 7:30am-3:30pm on school days and a bus zone; no overnight custom.

sun_shade: Trees on the west side shade the kerb in the afternoon; open to the east and north.
